_note: Words for the family page (scripts/family_page.py). Evidence states take their words from copy_evidence.json; these are the page's own labels and sentences. Every state is said in words; no symbol needs a key. Sentence case, plain, no em dashes.

head.quote_more: Read the rest of the description
head.problems_one: One problem has been reported by others; the atlas has not judged it.
head.problems_many: {n} problems have been reported by others; the atlas has not judged them.
head.erdos: It bears on {problems}, as listed by {source}.

verdict.all_both: Both outside readers find that the release’s Lean states or implies the whole headline.
verdict.all_one: {name}, the one outside reader to have read it so far, finds that the release’s Lean states or implies the whole headline.
verdict.part_both: The outside readers find that the release’s Lean states part of the headline, or a narrower statement.
verdict.part_one: {name}, the one outside reader to have read it so far, finds that the release’s Lean states part of the headline, or a narrower statement.
verdict.other_both: The outside readers find that the release’s Lean states a supporting or a different result.
verdict.other_one: {name}, the one outside reader to have read it so far, finds that the release’s Lean states a supporting or a different result.
verdict.split: The two outside readers disagree about how much of the headline the release’s Lean states.
verdict.unread: No outside reader has yet compared the release’s Lean with the headline.
verdict.none: The release has no Lean statement for this family, so there is nothing for an outside reader to compare with the headline.

papers_line.editions_one: one replaced by a later edition

status.formal_none: The release has no Lean statement for this family; the papers can still be read and checked by hand.
status.runs_it_by_one: one outside group reports accepting a re-run of it at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_it_by_many: {g} outside groups report accepting re-runs of it at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_one_by_one: one outside group reports accepting a re-run of one of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_one_by_many: {g} outside groups report accepting re-runs of one of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_all_by_one: one outside group reports accepting re-runs of all of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_all_by_many: outside groups report accepting re-runs of all of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_some_by_one: one outside group reports accepting re-runs of {k} of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_some_by_many: outside groups report accepting re-runs of {k} of them at the release’s recorded version
status.runs_none: no outside group reports an accepted re-run at the release’s recorded version
status.reading_all: each readable here as a page beside its PDF
status.reading_one: readable here as a page beside its PDF
status.reading_some: {k} readable here as pages, the others as PDFs
status.explained_reviewed: A reviewed explanation for the atlas: {links}.
status.explained_none: Nobody has written an explanation for the atlas yet.

claim.alternatives: Statements that share words with the description
claim.alternatives_other: Other statements that share words with the description
claim.alt_many: {n} other possible matches are {listed}, among them {items}.
claim.no_text: The statement’s text is on its reading page.
claim.explanations_intro: Explanations of this family written elsewhere, by the people named. Each is their own reading of the mathematics.
claim.unresolved: The release does not say which paper theorem its catalogue describes. The statements above share the most wording with the description; the atlas has not reviewed that choice.
claim.unresolved_one: The release does not say which paper theorem its catalogue describes. The statement above shares the most wording with the description; the atlas has not reviewed that choice.
claim.unresolved_none: The release does not say which paper theorem its catalogue describes, and no statement in its papers shares the description’s wording.
claim.state_primary: Possible match to the catalogue description: of the papers’ main statements, it shares the most wording with it. Not reviewed as the catalogue’s statement.
claim.state_alt: Possible match to the catalogue description, found from shared wording; not reviewed as the catalogue’s statement.
claim.no_lean_paired: No Lean statement in the release is paired with this theorem.
claim.state_main: Possible match to the catalogue description: the paper’s main theorem. Not reviewed as the catalogue’s statement.
claim.state_words: Possible match to the catalogue description: of the papers’ statements, it shares the most wording with it. Not reviewed as the catalogue’s statement.
claim.two_note: The release does not say which paper theorem its catalogue describes. Both statements above are shown whole: the paper’s main theorem first, then the statement that shares the most wording with the description. The atlas has not reviewed either choice.
claim.two_note_same: The release does not say which paper theorem its catalogue describes. Both statements above are shown whole, the closer match to the description’s wording first. The atlas has not reviewed either choice.

compare.heading: What the release’s Lean states
compare.intro: The paper’s theorem beside the Lean statement it is paired with. The words between them say how the two were joined.
compare.supporting_heading: What the release’s Lean states, and the theorem it is paired with
compare.index_intro: Choose one to see it beside the paper theorem it is paired with.

state_head.producer-cited-association: The Lean statement whose source cites this theorem
state_head.producer-declared-binding: The Lean statement the release binds to this theorem

state_qual.candidate-pairing: Suggested from shared wording. Correspondence not reviewed.
state_qual.producer-cited-association: The Lean source cites the theorem by its label. Correspondence not reviewed.
state_qual.producer-declared-binding: The release’s manifest binds them. Correspondence not reviewed.
state_qual.unavailable: No paper theorem is paired with it.

compare.no_pair: No paper theorem is paired with this Lean statement.
compare.paired_many: It is paired with {labels}, each shown below.
compare.lean_main: the release lists it as a main result
compare.lean_support: the release lists it as a supporting statement
compare.lean_more_one: The file states one more theorem:
compare.holes_one: Comparator compares one definition by its name and type only: {names}.
compare.holes_many: {n} definitions are compared by name and type only: {names}.
compare.nolean: The release has no Lean statement for this family. Its papers can still be read and checked by hand, and anyone can offer a formal statement.
compare.sorry: The challenge file states the theorem with sorry in place of its proof; the release’s solution file supplies the proof, and that is what a re-run checks.
compare.heading_one: One Lean statement in this family
compare.intro_one: The paper theorem the release’s Lean statement is paired with, beside it, with how the two were joined.
compare.row_candidate: Possible Lean counterpart of {label} in {paper}, found from shared wording; not reviewed.
compare.row_cited: Its source cites {label} in {paper}; the match is not reviewed.
compare.row_declared: The release binds it to {label} in {paper}; the match is not reviewed.
compare.row_none: No paper theorem is paired with it.
compare.comparator_once: A [[comparator|Comparator]] re-run checks OpenAI’s separate proof against a Lean statement, allowing only the axioms the [[challenge|challenge file]] permits. It does not say whether the statement matches the paper’s theorem; that is the outside readers’ question, below.

readings.heading: The outside readers
readings.intro: Two outside readers, {names}, have judged whether the release’s Lean states this family’s headline. Their readings concern the headline as a whole, not one paper theorem.

state.all: the Lean states or implies all of the headline
state.part: the Lean states part of the headline
state.narrower: the Lean states a narrower statement than the headline
state.weaker: the Lean states a weaker statement than the headline
state.supporting: the Lean states a supporting result
state.different: the Lean states a different result

readings.defs: Definitions they ask a reader to check
readings.draft_heading: An AI agent’s draft classifications, which nobody has reviewed
readings.draft_fold: {n} AI draft classifications, which nobody has reviewed
readings.producer: OpenAI’s own note on what its Lean covers
readings.producer_more: Read the rest of OpenAI’s note
readings.nolean: With no Lean statement in the release, there is nothing for an outside reader to compare with the headline.

reruns.heading: Who re-ran the Lean
reruns.intro: Outside groups report re-running the release’s Lean through Comparator. Each row is their report; the atlas did not re-run anything.
reruns.none: No outside group reports re-running this Lean statement.
reruns.common_pin_one: One report, at the release’s recorded version.
reruns.common_pin_many: {n} reports, all at the release’s recorded version.
reruns.common_many: {n} reports, each at the version its row gives.
reruns.details_none: None of these reports gives the toolchain, kernels, axioms used, time or memory as a separate field; where a report names any of them, it does so in its own words below.
reruns.more: Re-runs of the other {n} Lean statements
reruns.others_intro: Reports of re-runs from other people, as they describe them.

checks.heading: Checks by another method
checks.intro: Outside checks of the papers’ results that use something other than the release’s Lean: {kinds}. Each is the checker’s own report.
checks.intro_none: Outside checks of the papers’ results that use something other than the release’s Lean. Each is the checker’s own report.
checks.findings_intro: Statement Map, which assembles the atlas’s records, notes where its own reading of the source stopped short. These notes are about the records, not about the mathematics.
checks.problems_intro: Reports of errors and corrections from outside readers, as they state them. The atlas has not judged them.

states.reported-exact-confirmation: exact code confirms that the published object has the claimed property
states.reported-supporting-check: a proof card checks a supporting fact
states.reported-undecided: the check did not reach a verdict, which says nothing against the result
states.source-data-unavailable: the check needs data the source does not provide

left.heading: What is left to check
left.reader_note_ref: its request is printed in full under {link}.
left.intro: Each item names exactly what it concerns. Its link opens a GitHub form with that target and its fingerprint filled in, so a contribution stays tied to the text you read.

kinds.scope-review: Read the Lean statement against the paper
kinds.claim-identification: Identify the theorem the catalogue describes
kinds.reader-request: Check what an outside reader asks a reader to check
kinds.definition-review: Read the definitions the solution supplies

left.check_each: Check a Lean statement against the paper:

reasons.Lexical navigation candidate; catalogue: Nobody has yet confirmed which theorem the catalogue means. The one shown was chosen because it shares the most wording with the description.
reasons.No unique candidate with at least three: Nobody has yet confirmed which theorem the catalogue means, and no single statement in the papers clearly shares its wording.
reasons.Read the solution-supplied definitions a: The release’s solution supplies some definitions of its own. Nobody has yet checked that they mean the objects the paper means.
reasons.No Lean object is recorded for this fami: The release has no Lean statement for this family.
reasons.The attributed exact check is undecided: An outside exact check did not reach a verdict, or needs data the source does not give.
reasons.Recorded candidate or producer-declared: Nobody has yet checked whether each Lean statement and the paper theorem it is paired with say the same thing.
reasons.No imported accepted Comparator report b: No outside group has reported an accepted re-run at the release’s recorded version.
reasons.An AI scope draft has no named human rev: An AI agent has drafted how much of the paper this Lean statement covers; no named person has reviewed the draft.

left.reason_fallback: Nobody has yet checked this by hand.

papers.heading: Papers
papers.refs_intro: Each paper’s outside references are listed with it on its reading page, where each citation is placed. Every outside work cited in the release:
papers.intro: Each paper opens as a [[reading-page|reading page]] in the browser, with the PDF beside it. The statements each paper opens with are on its reading page.

said.heading: What people have said
said.intro: Commentary on this family by others, dated and credited. It is commentary, not a finding.

inspect.hint: Select to keep it open beside the page.

why.method_text: Its words were compared with the words of OpenAI’s catalogue description.
why.method_lean: Its words were compared with the words of the Lean statement {name}.
why.review_text: Nobody has reviewed whether it is the statement the catalogue means.
why.review_lean: Nobody has reviewed whether the two state the same thing.

source.label: The cited passage, from the paper

cites.heading: What these papers cite in the release, and what cites them
cites.cites_heading: Papers elsewhere in the release that this family’s papers cite
cites.cited_heading: Papers elsewhere in the release that cite this family’s papers
cites.cites_none: This family’s papers cite no paper elsewhere in the release.
cites.cited_none: No paper elsewhere in the release cites this family’s papers.
